cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

mechanism: A forbids the final physical search and directs reassurance to the keys as the sole acceptable explanation and action.
confusable: Unlike adding a fanciful explanation while still searching normally, A explicitly blocks checking under the cushion.
comparison: An audible key location competes with invisibility-by-anger, unlike a targeted lighting test.
seedUse: The seed already commands stopping, apologizing and no checking, enacting S01 authority over the rejected ordinary method.
